name: test-a-rank
report: test fixture: always an A rank
source: The variant tool's test fixture, in no tweak list: SA2 Mod Loader Codes.lst, Patch "Always Get A Rank" (writenop 0044F799 2, writenop 00450688 2)
why: 0x0044F670 and 0x004505D0 each grade a finished stage: from the rank byte at +2 of the record in ECX (0x0044F670) or EDI (0x004505D0), a loop of four steps raises the rank by one for each threshold passed, `jb 0x0044F7A3` at 0x0044F799 (the score below the threshold) or `jg 0x004506A6` at 0x00450688 (the time, minutes * 60 + seconds, above it) leaving the loop early; either way the function then stores the rank at 0x0174B001 and at +3 of the object at [0x01A5A230]. Two `nop`s in place of each exit run all four steps, so the rank is always four above where it started, the A; the rest of each function runs as before.
